name: Cash Account Characteristics 5
definition: Specifies the characteristics of the cash account.

AccountLevel.name: Account Level
AccountLevel.definition: Defines the account level within an account hierarchy.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

AccountServicer.name: Account Servicer
AccountServicer.definition: Usage: the account servicer is the domicile agent servicing the local account.

ParentAccount.name: Parent Account
ParentAccount.definition: Defines a parent account to which the cash account is related to.

CompensationMethod.name: Compensation Method
CompensationMethod.definition: Defines if and how charges and taxes due are paid to the financial institution.

DebitAccount.name: Debit Account
DebitAccount.definition: Defines the account debited for charges and taxes due on the cash account, if different from the cash account.

DelayedDebitDate.name: Delayed Debit Date
DelayedDebitDate.definition: Future date on which the account will be automatically debited for charges and taxes due.

SettlementAdvice.name: Settlement Advice
SettlementAdvice.definition: Free form message advising the customer about the settlement of charges and taxes due.

AccountBalanceCurrencyCode.name: Account Balance Currency Code
AccountBalanceCurrencyCode.definition: Currency used to specify the account's balance currency.

SettlementCurrencyCode.name: Settlement Currency Code
SettlementCurrencyCode.definition: Currency used to specify the account's settlement currency.

HostCurrencyCode.name: Host Currency Code
HostCurrencyCode.definition: Currency used to specify the account's taxing host currency.

AccountServicerContact.name: Account Servicer Contact
AccountServicerContact.definition: Individual to contact at the financial institution's location regarding problems of a business nature.
